Six artists sing for Independence Day
2016-03-19T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/showbiz/six-artists-sing-independence-day-1196170

Six artists across several generations are coming together to collaborate for one Independence Day song. The artists are Samina Rahman, Syed Abdul Hadi, Partha Barua, Shafiq Tuhin, Kona and Imran. The song is a patriotic number that goes – "Onek Daam e Pawa Tumi, Rokto Diye Kena..." written by Shafiq Tuhin with Marcel as the music director. The recording has been completed at Premix Studios and the audio-video production is underway at Eagle Music, and it is scheduled for release on TV and on YouTube on March 26.
